targets.name: job-store
targets.rationale: Job state transitions back long-running route behavior and must not silently regress.

targets.name: path-resolution
targets.rationale: Path validation is a security boundary; mutation survivors are treated as high-priority signal.

targets.name: registry
targets.rationale: Registry contracts define node/API surface area and should be resistant to subtle branch mutations.

targets.name: output-assembler
targets.rationale: The OUTPUT assembler is the schema-determined cut planner and serialiser behind the {frames + field-map} to JSON boundary. Its witness command includes unit, nested round-trip, documented nesting, v2 inference, and exact checkpoint-boundary contracts. The measured local survivor rate is 9.09% against the unchanged 10% ceiling after syntax-only annotation and keyword-marker exclusions; executable planner and assembly behavior remains in scope.

targets.name: jsonpath
targets.rationale: The single-sourced path-grammar core (PATH_GRAMMAR.md) — acceptance, canonicality, and the canonical writer. Both INPUT and OUTPUT depend on it, so subtle branch mutations are high-priority signal. Residual survivors are five equivalent mutants: '==' -> 'is' on single-char (interned) dispatch, '<' -> '!='/'is not' on a loop bound that never overshoots, and '==' -> '>=' on the canonical-writer round-trip (a canonical re-emit never lexically exceeds its input).

targets.name: json-shred
targets.rationale: The structured-input engine is the load-bearing JSON/JSONL/XML decomposition, bounded-spill, cache-publication, source-proof, cross-process-lock, and runtime-snapshot boundary. Its maintained 1,047-test mutation command exercises parser conservation, multi-port loading, native source revisions, direct spill limits, atomic prepare/commit/discard, recovery, concurrent locking, source invalidation, process ownership, and adversarial cleanup paths. Broad tests with no unique kills in the latest complete run remain in normal CI but are excluded from the per-mutant command; demonstrated parallel killers and fast deterministic pool witnesses stay included. The isolated Windows baseline is 58.8 seconds in pytest and 62.0 seconds end to end under the unchanged 90-second ceiling. The 5% survival ceiling remains unchanged as the module grows. Only proven-equivalent selection and syntax-only postponed annotations are excluded with reviewed pragmas; executable expressions and branch decisions remain mutation-tested.

targets.name: json-cache
targets.rationale: The v2 per-port JSON cache route owns build/status/cancel/progress/infer/delete orchestration over the shred engine. Focused witnesses cover path confinement, exact worker-manifest binding under adversarial equality overloads, native-memory diagnostics, progress reference counts and timing, and response aggregation. The measured local survivor rate is 8.56% against the unchanged 11% ceiling after syntax-only exclusions.

targets.name: executor
targets.rationale: The graph executor runs live Polars pipelines across preview, projection, materialisation, caching, sandboxed code, and transactional outputs. The maintained witnesses cover resource defaults, prepared-output immutability, path confinement, preamble safety, preview budgets, cache completeness, graph execution, model scoring, tracing, and output publication. Syntax-only postponed annotations and keyword markers are excluded; executable decisions remain under the unchanged 15% ceiling.
